q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password." We will email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: Der Plus-Plan kostet 4 US-Dollar pro Monat. Eine jährliche Abrechnung spart 20 %. Es bietet unbegrenzte Notizen und bis zu 3 Geräte.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 users, that would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to the monthly rate.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: According to the FAQ, the Free plan allows up to 100 notes and is limited to 1 device.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, you can get a full refund. Plus subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: You can get a refund, as Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number for assistance.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Yes, we don't have a Linux desktop app, but you can use our web app on any modern browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. You can see the list of supported platforms in our FAQ. Please let me know if you have other questions.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs an internet connection. The mobile and desktop apps work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can recover it from Trash within 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore."

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: On ne prend pas en charge l’authentification par SMS pour la vérification en deux étapes. Vous pouvez configurer l’option via une application d’authentification dans les paramètres de sécurité.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: If you cancel today, you keep Plus features until the end of your current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: Email support@example.com. We reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, Plus and Team plans billed annually save 20% compared to monthly billing.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Per informazioni, non posso aiutarti con la tua domanda sullo sconto studenti perché non è trattata nelle nostre FAQ. Ti consiglio la soluzione standard: contatta support@example.com per aprire un ticket di supporto.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer:
I don't know.  
I can open a support ticket for you to get an official answer on this.  
For direct help, you can email support@example.com.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know how to import notes from other services. However, I can open a support ticket for you to get help with your specific question.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: According to the FAQ, there is currently no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app. The FAQ does not provide a release date for a future Linux app. Please contact support if you have further feedback on this topic.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I don't have that information. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you instead?

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I'm sorry, but I can only answer questions related to Example Notes. For weather information, please check a weather service or app.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: Plus and Team plans support attachments up to 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Yes. Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックしてください。30分で有効期限が切れるリセット用リンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I understand you're frustrated with lost notes. Deleted notes remain in Trash for 30 days, where you can restore them. If this doesn't solve the issue, I can open a support ticket for you.
